name: Ocelot Pride
clause: Ascend / "Then if you have the city's blessing, for each token you control that entered this turn, create a token that's a copy of it."

needs.proposedSignature: Effect { op: 'ascend' } (the instant/sorcery form) ; StaticEffect { kind: 'ascend' } (the permanent form, re-checked whenever permanents change) ; Condition { kind: 'city-blessing'; who?: ScopeWho } ; a per-player sticky designation slot on Player (e.g. designations: Set<'city-blessing' | 'monarch' | 'initiative'>) ; a KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS entry for 'ascend'
needs.semantics: CR 702.131a/b: on an instant or sorcery Ascend is a spell ability checked on resolution; on a permanent it is a static ability checked continuously (any time you control ten or more permanents). The city's blessing is a DESIGNATION, not a counter or a permanent state, and once gained it is never lost — that stickiness is exactly why { kind: 'controls', who: 'you', filter: {}, atLeast: 10 } is not a faithful stand-in. Once the Condition exists it plugs into every place this batch needs it: a triggered ability's intervening (Twilight Prophet), anthem.condition (Tendershoot Dryad, Illustrious Wanderglyph), activateOnlyIf (Arch of Orazca), a conditional inside an effect list (Anduril, Vona's Hunger) and self-keywords.condition (Wayward Swordtooth). A shared designation slot would also give the existing become-monarch op a readable Condition, which it lacks today.
needs.clause: "Ascend" and every "if you have the city's blessing" / "as long as you have the city's blessing" / "unless you have the city's blessing" / "Activate only if you have the city's blessing" clause

needs.semantics: Matches a permanent that entered the battlefield this turn, so a for-each can iterate 'each token you control that entered this turn'. The engine already answers the same fact about the source as the Condition self-entered-this-turn; this is that fact as a Filter field so it can name a SET rather than only the source. Ocelot Pride is the only card in this batch that needs it, and it needs the ascend family too.
needs.clause: for each token you control that entered this turn, create a token that's a copy of it
